title: maclura thorelii
intro: Maclura thorelii, commonly known as the Chinese osage orange, is a plant species in the family Moraceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
